signature_moves.description: The traditional concluding step of a Juba performance
signature_moves.name: Long Dog Scratch

signature_moves.description: A specific rhythmic step mentioned in historical accounts
signature_moves.name: Blow That Candle Out

music_profile.musical_form: AABB or repetitive rhythmic cycles with vocal rhymes
music_profile.sound_description: A layered percussive soundscape created entirely by the human body, featuring deep thuds from chest-patting, sharp cracks from hand-claps, and rhythmic shuffling or stomping of the feet, often overlaid with rhythmic chanting.

basic_steps: Stomp the feet to establish a base pulse
Slap the thighs with alternating hands
Pat the chest to create a deeper percussive tone
Clap the hands in syncopated patterns
Slap the cheeks for higher-pitched accents
teaching.formation: Often performed in a circle or as part of a walkaround
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on the coordination between foot stomps and hand slaps before attempting the 'Long Dog Scratch'.
teaching.rhythm: Complex syncopated patterns, often following a call-and-response structure
